# CLI Reference

<!-- Generated by `go run ./tools/clidoc > docs/cli-reference.md`; don't edit by hand. -->

Every `rackd` command and its flags, as `rackd <command> --help` prints them. See [CLI](cli.md) for configuration, output formats and examples.

## `rackd server`

```text
Name:
   rackd server - Start the HTTP/MCP server

Usage:
   rackd server [flags]

Flags:
       --data-dir string            Data directory (default: ./data)
       --listen-addr string         Listen address (default: :8080)
       --log-level string           Log level (trace/debug/info/warn/error)
                                    (default: info)
       --log-format string          Log format (text/json) (default: text)
       --discovery-interval string  Discovery scan interval (default: 24h)
       --dev-mode bool              Development mode (relaxes security: no TLS
                                    cookies, no rate limiting, allows missing
                                    ENCRYPTION_KEY)

Global Flags:
   -h, --help  Show help for the command
```

## `rackd credentials`

```text
Name:
   rackd credentials - Manage credentials and encryption

Usage:
   rackd credentials [flags] [command]

Available Commands:
   rotate-key      Re-encrypt credentials, DNS provider tokens and webhook secrets with a new key

Global Flags:
   -h, --help  Show help for the command
```

### `rackd credentials rotate-key`

```text
Name:
   rackd credentials rotate-key - Re-encrypt credentials, DNS provider tokens and webhook secrets with a new key

Usage:
   rackd credentials rotate-key [flags]

Description:
   Reads the current key from ENCRYPTION_KEY and the new one from the
   environment variable --new-key-env names (NEW_ENCRYPTION_KEY by default) or
   from --new-key-file, so neither appears in the process list or shell history.
   Stop the server first: everything is re-encrypted in one transaction, and a
   running server would keep writing with the old key.

Flags:
       --data-dir string      Data directory containing rackd.db
                              (default: ./data)
       --new-key-env string   Environment variable holding the new
                              64-hex-character key (default: NEW_ENCRYPTION_KEY)
       --new-key-file string  File holding the new key (overrides --new-key-env)
       --yes bool             Confirm that the server is stopped

Global Flags:
   -h, --help  Show help for the command
```

## `rackd migrate`

```text
Name:
   rackd migrate - Database migration management

Usage:
   rackd migrate [flags] [command]

Available Commands:
   status          Show migration status for core and each extension
   run             Run pending migrations for core and each extension, backing up the database first
   rollback        Revert applied migrations of core or one extension, backing up the database first

Global Flags:
   -h, --help  Show help for the command
```

### `rackd migrate rollback`

```text

Flags:

                           (default: core)
       --steps int         Number of migrations to revert (default: 1)
```
